import collections
def state(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    dots = collections.Counter(((r-12)//6,(c-11)//6) for r in range(12,64) for c in range(11,64) if a[r][c]=='N')
    G = collections.Counter(((r-12)//6,(c-11)//6) for r in range(1,64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='G')
    g = collections.Counter(((r-12)//6,(c-11)//6) for r in range(1,64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='g')
    return {k:v for k,v in dots.items()}, dict(G), dict(g)
base = state(current_frame)
print("base dots:", base[0])
for dot,(r,c) in [("(1,1)",(19,18)), ("(1,2)",(19,24))]:
    for d in ['UP','DOWN','LEFT','RIGHT']:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
        action([d])
        s = state(current_frame)
        changed = s[0]!=base[0]
        print(dot, d, "dots_changed" if changed else "", "ring:", s[1], "pat:", s[2])
        if changed:
            print("NEW DOTS:", s[0]); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
